description: Source code for printing Lua bytecode, including functions for printing strings, constants, code, headers, and nested functions.

methods.name: PrintString
methods.description: Prints a Lua string with escape characters.

methods.name: PrintConstant
methods.description: Prints a constant value from a Lua function prototype.

methods.name: PrintCode
methods.description: Prints the bytecode instructions of a Lua function prototype.

methods.name: PrintHeader
methods.description: Prints header information of a Lua function prototype.

methods.name: PrintConstants
methods.description: Prints all constants used in a Lua function prototype.

methods.name: PrintLocals
methods.description: Prints local variables of a Lua function prototype.

methods.name: PrintUpvalues
methods.description: Prints upvalues of a Lua function prototype.

methods.name: PrintFunction
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a Lua function prototype, optionally including nested functions.
